Check for required R package dependencies

Source: R/utility_library.R
mysterycall_check_dependencies.Rd

Check for required R package dependencies

Usage

mysterycall_check_dependencies(
  packages,
  install = FALSE,
  repos = getOption("repos"),
  quietly = FALSE
)

Arguments

packages

Character vector of package names to verify.

install

Logical; when TRUE, attempt to install missing packages using install.packages(). Defaults to FALSE.

repos

Character vector of repositories to forward to install.packages() when install = TRUE.

quietly

Logical flag controlling console output. When TRUE, suppresses status messages.

Value

A tibble summarising the dependency status for each package.

Examples

# \donttest{
mysterycall_check_dependencies(c("dplyr", "sf"), install = FALSE)
#> Error in !summary$installed: invalid argument type
# }
